operation.title: Resolve reuse decision: honestdid
operation.action: Inspect this entry and any canonical alias at a pinned revision. Choose adopt, integrate, port, reference, defer or reject with reasons. An umbrella lead must be resolved into concrete candidates; cite its source and license rather than borrowing family-level approval.
criteria: Bind source/version/license/dependency and maintenance evidence; distinguish alias/lead from a distinct engine.
Explain target/uncertainty semantics, alternatives, costs, owner obligations and revisit trigger.

Grant integration_allowed only for a selected permissible pinned path with a behavioral oracle and documented conversion/failure contract; rejection may finish the decision without enabling an adapter.
operation.owner_role: Current author/coordinator; external evidence retains its authentic named owner
operation.failure_action: Preserve findings and exact evidence. Record a scoped negative/inconclusive outcome or a blocker with acquisition/research trigger. Continue the next ready lane; no automatic phase stop.

rule: Perform, review and record; continue another eligible task after every outcome or local blocker.
